description: This file is a PHP class 'ExpressionParser' that parses and processes expressions in Twig templates, implementing a precedence climbing algorithm for expression parsing, handling various expression types, operators, and syntax features.

classes.name: ExpressionParser
classes.description: This class implements the parsing logic for Twig expressions, using precedence climbing to handle operator precedence, various expression types, function calls, and syntax features within Twig templates.

methods.name: parseExpression
methods.description: Parses an expression with optional precedence, handling binary operators, arrow functions, and conditional expressions.

methods.name: getPrimary
methods.description: Retrieves the primary expression node based on the current token, handling literals, variables, grouped expressions, and unary operators.

methods.name: parseConditionalExpression
methods.description: Parses ternary conditional expressions within Twig templates.

methods.name: parsePrimaryExpression
methods.description: Parses primary expressions (variables, literals, grouped expressions) based on the current token.

methods.name: parsePostfixExpression
methods.description: Handles postfix expressions like subscripting, filtering, and method calls after a primary expression.

methods.name: parseStringExpression
methods.description: Parses string and interpolated expressions into concatenated node structures.

methods.name: parseArrayExpression
methods.description: Deprecated. Parses array expressions; delegates to 'parseSequenceExpression'.

methods.name: parseSequenceExpression
methods.description: Parses list (sequence) expressions delimited by brackets.

methods.name: parseHashExpression
methods.description: Deprecated. Parses mapping expressions; delegates to 'parseMappingExpression'.

methods.name: parseMappingExpression
methods.description: Parses associative array (mapping) expressions delimited by braces.

methods.name: parseSubscriptExpression
methods.description: Parses subscript expressions, handling dot and array notation.

methods.name: parseSubscriptExpressionDot
methods.description: Parses property access via dot notation.

methods.name: parseSubscriptExpressionArray
methods.description: Parses property access via array notation.

methods.name: parseFilterExpression
methods.description: Parses filter expressions applied to nodes.

methods.name: parseFilterExpressionRaw
methods.description: Parses filter chains, with optional arguments, creating corresponding filter nodes.

methods.name: parseArguments
methods.description: Parses argument lists for functions, filters, etc., supporting named and positional arguments.

methods.name: parseAssignmentExpression
methods.description: Parses assignment target expressions.

methods.name: parseMultitargetExpression
methods.description: Parses multiple expressions, typically for multiple assignments.

methods.name: parseNotTestExpression
methods.description: Wraps an expression with a NotUnary for 'not' tests.

methods.name: parseTestExpression
methods.description: Parses test expressions using 'test' functions or conditions.

methods.name: getTest
methods.description: Retrieves a test object based on the token stream, supporting multi-word tests and deprecation warnings.

methods.name: getFunction
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a Twig function node from the environment, with deprecation handling.

methods.name: getFilter
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a Twig filter node from the environment, with deprecation handling.

methods.name: checkConstantExpression
methods.description: Checks recursively if a node is a constant expression suitable for certain contexts.

methods.name: setDeprecationCheck
methods.description: Sets whether deprecation warnings should be triggered during parsing.

methods.name: createArguments
methods.description: Creates an ArrayExpression node from parsed arguments.

methods.name: parseOnlyArguments
methods.description: Parses a list of arguments, supporting spread operators and named arguments.

methods.name: parseSubscriptExpressionDot
methods.description: Parses property access via dot notation, supporting optional method calls.

methods.name: parseSubscriptExpressionArray
methods.description: Parses property access via array notation, including slices.
